title: Context as Infrastructure: Knowledge Compilation for Retrieval in Agentic Systems with Harnesses
abstract: arXiv:2610.41172v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation is becoming agentic. A search harness writes queries, reads results, reformulates, and decides when to stop. This largely solves accuracy: a harness with only BM25/grep and MiniMax M3 answers 85% of BrowseComp-Plus and 91% on multi-hop FRAMES in our runs, without compiled or vector indexes. It exposes a context problem: an undisciplined loop repeats queries, rereads documents, and fills the window with unused passages. The missing layer is knowledge compilation: a configurable ingestion pipeline where LLMs enrich documents with context no chunk contains alone--navigation hierarchies with claim-evidence leaves, entity graphs, timelines, mind maps, ontologies, wikis, and memory. Compilation is not a better retriever: under a competent harness, structural artifacts gave no detectable accuracy gain on FRAMES, and a PageIndex-style outline degraded at scale. translated_title: 上下文即基础设施：带执行框架的智能体系统中用于检索的知识编译
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成正在走向智能体化。一个搜索执行框架会撰写查询、阅读结果、重新表述查询，并决定何时停止。这在很大程度上解决了准确性问题：在我们的实验中，仅配备 BM25/grep 与 MiniMax M3 的执行框架，在不使用编译索引或向量索引的情况下，即可在 BrowseComp-Plus 上达到 85% 的准确率，在多跳 FRAMES 上达到 91%。但这同时暴露出一个上下文问题：不受约束的循环会重复提交查询、反复阅读文档，并用未被使用的段落填满上下文窗口。缺失的一层是知识编译：一条可配置的文档摄取流水线，由大语言模型为文档注入任何单个文本块都无法独立包含的上下文——带有论断-证据叶节点的导航层次结构、实体图、时间线、思维导图、本体、维基和记忆。编译并不是一个更好的检索器：在一个称职的执行框架下，结构化工件在 FRAMES 上没有带来可检测的准确性提升，而 PageIndex 式大纲在规模扩大时反而出现退化。它是一个供给层。一棵导航树，其叶节点……
tldr: 提出“知识编译”应作为智能体检索的上下文基础设施：在搜索执行框架已基本解决准确性问题的前提下，通过可配置的摄取流水线为文档注入导航树、实体图、时间线等结构化上下文，充当解决上下文浪费问题的“供给层”，而非充当更准确的检索器。
en_tdlr: Proposes knowledge compilation as a supply-layer infrastructure for agentic retrieval: once a search harness has largely solved accuracy, a configurable ingestion pipeline should enrich documents with structured context artifacts (navigation trees, entity graphs, timelines) to address the harness's context-waste problem—serving as a supply layer rather than a more accurate retriever.
